explanation:
本题是 Card Range Obfuscation 的第 4 部分，前三部分的规则全部保留，这一部分只多出一步：补完空洞后，把首尾相接且品牌相同的区间合并成一个。

## 思路

1. 把每个 10 位区间端点拼上 BIN，转成 16 位整数，避免字符串比较出错。
2. 按 `start` 升序、`end` 降序排序。这样一个大区间总排在它包含的子区间前面，扫描时只要当前区间的 `end` 不超过上一个外层区间的 `end`，它就是被包含的子区间（Part 3），单独放进 `inner`，不参与补洞。
3. 对外层区间补洞：第一个的 `start` 拉到 `BIN000…0`，最后一个的 `end` 拉到 `BIN999…9`（Part 1）；相邻两个之间的空洞交给左边那个，即 `outer[i].end = outer[i+1].start - 1`（Part 2）。
4. 顺序扫描外层区间，若当前区间与结果末尾品牌相同且 `末尾.end + 1 == 当前.start`，就把末尾的 `end` 延长；否则新开一段（Part 4）。
5. 把 `inner` 放回，按 `start` 排序后转回 16 位字符串输出。

样例 2：两个 VISA 区间先被补成 `0…4999999999` 和 `5000000000…7999999999`，二者首尾相接且同为 VISA，合并成 `0…7999999999`；MASTERCARD 不同品牌，单独保留。

## 正确性

补洞之后外层区间两两相邻、恰好铺满整个 BIN 范围，所以"能否合并"只取决于相邻两段的品牌是否相同。一次从左到右扫描时，每一段要么接到前一段末尾，要么另起，连续的同品牌段会被一路合并成一段，不会漏掉，也不会把不同品牌并在一起。

## 复杂度

排序 `O(N log N)`，补洞和合并各扫一遍 `O(N)`；额外空间 `O(N)`。

## 易错点

- 端点必须按整数比较和加减，`end + 1` 用字符串做会出错；输出时用 `zfill(16)` 补回前导零。
- 合并只发生在补洞之后，不能先合并再补洞（样例 2 中两个 VISA 原本并不相邻）。
- 题面没有给出 Part 3 嵌套区间在最终输出中的写法，这里假设子区间原样保留在输出里，与外层一起按 `start` 排序；如果评测要求丢弃子区间，删掉 `inner` 即可。
explanationEn:
This is Part 4 of Card Range Obfuscation. All rules from Parts 1-3 still apply; the only new step is that, after the gaps are filled, adjacent intervals with the same brand are merged.

## Approach

1. Prefix each 10-digit endpoint with the BIN and convert it to a 16-digit integer, so comparisons and `+1` are numeric.
2. Sort by `start` ascending, then `end` descending. A covering interval then always comes before the intervals it contains; any interval whose `end` does not exceed the last outer interval's `end` is a nested one (Part 3). Put it in `inner` and do not extend it.
3. Fill gaps on the outer intervals: the first one starts at `BIN000...0`, the last one ends at `BIN999...9` (Part 1), and every middle gap goes to the interval on its left: `outer[i].end = outer[i+1].start - 1` (Part 2).
4. Sweep the outer intervals; if the current one has the same brand as the last merged one and `last.end + 1 == cur.start`, extend `last.end`; otherwise start a new segment (Part 4).
5. Add `inner` back, sort by `start`, and format every endpoint as a 16-digit string.

In example 2 the two VISA intervals become `0...4999999999` and `5000000000...7999999999` after gap filling; they touch and share a brand, so they merge into `0...7999999999`, while MASTERCARD stays separate.

## Correctness

After gap filling the outer intervals tile the whole BIN range with no gaps, so two neighbours can be merged exactly when their brands match. A single left-to-right sweep either extends the previous segment or starts a new one, so every maximal run of same-brand neighbours becomes one interval and different brands are never combined.

## Complexity

Sorting is `O(N log N)`; gap filling and merging are `O(N)`. Extra space is `O(N)`.

## Pitfalls

- Do arithmetic on integers, not strings; pad back to 16 digits with `zfill(16)` when printing.
- Merge only after filling gaps; in example 2 the VISA intervals are not adjacent until the gap is filled.
- The statement does not say how nested intervals from Part 3 appear in the output. This solution assumes they are kept as-is and sorted together with the outer intervals; drop `inner` if the judge expects them removed.
